AlarmDescription: More than 50% of eval sessions have no invoke_agent span (all evaluator scores null with no error.type). Ratio is IF(total > 0, span_missing / total, 0) over the dimensionless fleet-rollup series the eval-packager emits (TEAM-3386) — CloudWatch rejects alarms built on SEARCH() expressions. A zero-total period (e.g. an all-duplicates delivery, which emits EvalSessionsTotal=0) necessarily has span_missing=0, so the IF() guard pins the ratio to 0, non-breaching for GreaterThanThreshold 0.5. Fires on 3 of 4 hourly datapoints. Requires the eval-packager version that emits the dimensionless rollup (TEAM-3386) to be deployed first. INSUFFICIENT_DATA when no eval sessions arrive.
